name: How long does it take to replace a standard light fixture?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a standard light fixture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a standard light fixture typically takes a professional electrician between 30 minutes to 2 hours. This timeframe can vary based on factors such as the accessibility of the fixture, the complexity of the wiring, and any unforeseen issues encountered during removal of the old unit or installation of the new one. More intricate fixtures, like chandeliers, may take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard light fixture replacement by a professional usually takes 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on complexity and accessibility.
